_: The thirteen V90Phase4Modulator members that neither print nor call a
peer's method, against t_v90p4mtab.  The claims worth attacking are the
two tables' SIGN PATTERNS and SOURCE ROWS, the two moduli and the -1 in
the six readers' index, the companding branch, and which of the six
storing members touches the CP record.
P4M_LEVEL is a macro, so a mutation to it moves all eighteen call sites
at once; the per-element mutations below anchor on the assignment lines
instead, which is what keeps a wrong row or a wrong sign separable from
